findings.issue: Pagination offset formula is off by one pageSize, skipping the first page
findings.evidence: getBooksPage computes OFFSET as `page * pageSize` instead of `(page - 1) * pageSize`, despite its own comment stating 'page starts at 1'. page=1 returns items 11-20 (pageSize=10), and the true first page is never reachable.

findings.issue: Rating validation condition is tautologically false, so no out-of-range rating is ever rejected
findings.evidence: `if (!Number.isInteger(rating) || (rating < 1 && rating > 5))` — no number can be both <1 AND >5, so only non-integers are rejected; ratings like 0, -5, or 999 pass and get persisted via Review.updateReview.

findings.issue: SQL injection via unvalidated `sort` query param interpolated into a raw SQL ORDER BY clause
findings.evidence: `const sort = (req.query.sort as string) || 'r.created_at DESC';` flows unchecked into Stats.getReviewsSorted(bookId, sort), which builds `ORDER BY ${sort}` via template literal with no whitelist — unlike the sibling getBooksPage, which whitelists against BOOK_SORT_COLUMNS.

findings.issue: Stored XSS via unescaped display_name in the top-review HTML fragment
findings.evidence:
`res.send(`
${top.display_name} rated it ${top.rating}/5
`)` interpolates user-controlled display_name into raw HTML with no escaping, unlike the res.render-based views used elsewhere in the same file.
